verdict.rationale: Carta is a cap-table management product, so issuing signed electronic share certificates is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions share certificates, in-platform legal signing, or linking a certificate to a cap table entry. The pack covers only API read access to cap tables, stakeholders and option grants, plus draft option grant creation, which is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue electronic share certificates that are legally signed in-platform and permanently linked to the cap table entry they represent
